quest.title: Irodori Poetry: Part I
quest.description: The Mondstadt bard Lenne is discussing poetry quite passionately with the Inazuman poet Ootomo...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventurer's Experience x4, Wanderer's Advice x8

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mister}, I see that you've been walking back and forth in this area for some time now. I believe you must be someone who appreciates the elegance of the arts.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: There is a question of elegance that I might need your help with. Would you mind lending me your aid?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, what is it?

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Though I have only just met this man, Lenne, a bard from Mondstadt, over here, we have already become fast friends.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Ootomo speaks the truth. We have only known each other for a few days, but I already have the greatest respect for his great learning.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Hehe, you are too kind, Lenne. In any case, we have made friends through poetry, and we're taking this opportunity to write a few collaborative works.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: And since Lenne has gone through all the effort to come to Inazuma, he really wants to add a bit of that Inazuman flavor to his work.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Indeed. Unfortunately, my itinerary has been far too tight. I haven't had time to really go around and see the sights.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what can I do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Friend, the theme of the poem I wish to write is "nostalgia."

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Upon seeing the sights in a distant land, a vagabond cannot help but remember their home. That is why I need to add some things into my poem that symbolize this distant place.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Could you help me take a few pictures from which I can draw some inspiration?

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Inazuma should have a great number of unique sights to see, yes? For example, when you speak of Mondstadt, everyone's minds will turn to Dandelions or Windwheel Asters...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, Paimon gets it now. Well in that case, let's take a few pictures of some of Inazuma's regional specialties! That should do it.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Indeed, I would be in your debt if you would! Allow me to also write a copy of my half-done poem manuscript, just for you to use as reference material.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: As for the number of pictures that I will need, I think <color=#00E1FFFF>4</color>, each showcasing different contents, will do. I will also pay for any travel fees you may incur in the process.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, {NICKNAME}, since Lenne's request seems clear, let's head out right now!

talks.objective: Prepare 4 photos of Inazuman regional specialties related to the theme

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Have you finished taking those pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet...

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Remember, you just need to take <color=#00E1FFFF>4</color> pictures of Inazuman regional specialties.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Hmmm, purple symbolizes Her Excellency. These two lines really do have an Inazuman flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mister}... You truly have a good eye.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Ootomo, since both you and our new friend here are both very enamored of these two lines, then let us use them.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Friend, thank you once again for your aid.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you. Have you finished taking those pictures?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've taken them.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Wonderful! You have my thanks. Let me have a look... Oh my, I've never seen any of these! ...And ah, this picture is wonderful! This one also seems quite noteworthy...

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Friend, your photos are a true inspiration! Many thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: Now, I have attempted to write several different stanzas according to the pictures you provided me. I'm quite torn as to which to use...

dialogues.speaker: Lenne
dialogues.text: I'm quite curious, actually. If it were you, which would you use?

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: Hmmm, the meaning of these two is that "the wind brings the flowers' fragrance," which is intimately linked to the line that follows immediately after.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: The emotions in these two are very strongly felt, and the atmosphere they create is quite ethereal.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: These two match the preceding lines the closest, and they are rhythmically fitting when read.

dialogues.speaker: Ootomo
dialogues.text: These two lines discuss the gains and losses we sustain with the passage of time, and how someone journeying far abroad comes to understand the meaning of home.
